articles.title: Kargil Vijay Diwas — 26 July 1999
articles.summary: Kargil Vijay Diwas commemorates India’s victory in the 1999 Kargil War and honours the Armed Forces’ sacrifice.
articles.summary_hi: कारगिल विजय दिवस 1999 कारगिल युद्ध में भारत की विजय और सशस्त्र बलों के बलिदान का स्मरण करता है।
articles.content:
Kargil Vijay Diwas is observed every year on 26 July to mark the successful conclusion of Operation Vijay in the Kargil War of 1999.

Pakistani intruders occupied high Himalayan posts in the Kargil sector. The Indian Army and Indian Air Force (Operation Safed Sagar) evicted them after intense high-altitude combat.

The Kargil War Memorial at Dras (Ladakh) is a major site of remembrance. Param Vir Chakra awardees include Capt. Vikram Batra and Capt. Manoj Pandey.

For IB ACIO: 26 July, 1999, Operation Vijay, Operation Safed Sagar (IAF).
articles.content_hi:
26 जुलाई — Operation Vijay (1999)। IAF: Operation Safed Sagar।

Dras वॉर मेमोरियल। IB ACIO: 26 July, 1999 — याद रखें।
articles.question: Kargil Vijay Diwas is celebrated on which date?
articles.question_hi: कारगिल विजय दिवस किस तिथि को मनाया जाता है?
articles.explanation: Kargil Vijay Diwas is observed on 26 July every year.
articles.explanation_hi: कारगिल विजय दिवस हर वर्ष 26 जुलाई को मनाया जाता है।
articles.moreInfo: 16 December Vijay Diwas marks 1971 war victory — do not confuse.
articles.moreInfo_hi: 16 दिसंबर विजय दिवस = 1971 युद्ध — भ्रमित न हों।

articles.title: Operation Vijay and Operation Safed Sagar
articles.title_hi: ऑपरेशन विजय और ऑपरेशन सफेद सागर
articles.summary: Operation Vijay was the Army’s campaign; Operation Safed Sagar was the IAF’s air campaign in the Kargil War.
articles.summary_hi: ऑपरेशन विजय थलसेना का अभियान; ऑपरेशन सफेद सागर वायुसेना का कारगिल हवाई अभियान।
articles.content:
During the Kargil conflict (May–July 1999), the Indian Army launched Operation Vijay to reclaim peaks. The Indian Air Force conducted Operation Safed Sagar — its first large-scale use of air power in the region since 1971, under strict rules of engagement.

High-altitude warfare, sparse oxygen, and steep ridges made logistics and artillery critical. The conflict reinforced the need for better surveillance and border management.

For IB ACIO: Army = Vijay; IAF = Safed Sagar; year 1999.
articles.content_hi:
थलसेना: Operation Vijay। वायुसेना: Operation Safed Sagar। वर्ष 1999।

IB ACIO: दोनों ऑपरेशन नाम — याद रखें।
articles.question: Operation Safed Sagar was conducted by which force?
articles.question_hi: ऑपरेशन सफेद सागर किस बल ने चलाया?
articles.explanation: Operation Safed Sagar was the Indian Air Force operation in Kargil.
articles.explanation_hi: ऑपरेशन सफेद सागर कारगिल में भारतीय वायुसेना का अभियान था।

articles.title: International Day for Conservation of Mangrove Ecosystem — 26 July
articles.title_hi: मैंग्रोव पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र संरक्षण अंतर्राष्ट्रीय दिवस — 26 जुलाई
articles.summary: UNESCO observes 26 July as International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem.
articles.summary_hi: UNESCO 26 जुलाई को मैंग्रोव पारिस्थितिकी संरक्षण अंतर्राष्ट्रीय दिवस मनाता है।
articles.content:
The International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem is celebrated on 26 July under UNESCO’s lead.

Mangroves protect coasts, store blue carbon, and support biodiversity and livelihoods. India’s Sundarbans is among the world’s largest mangrove forests and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Conservation links to cyclone resilience on India’s east coast.

For IB ACIO: 26 July, UNESCO, Sundarbans example.
articles.content_hi:
26 जुलाई — UNESCO मैंग्रोव दिवस। सुंदरबन विश्व धरोहर।

IB ACIO: 26 July, mangroves — याद रखें।
articles.question: Which organisation leads the International Day for Mangrove Conservation?
articles.question_hi: मैंग्रोव संरक्षण अंतर्राष्ट्रीय दिवस किस संगठन से जुड़ा है?
articles.explanation: UNESCO observes the International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem.
articles.explanation_hi: UNESCO मैंग्रोव संरक्षण अंतर्राष्ट्रीय दिवस मनाता है।

articles.title: Agnipath Scheme — Agniveers in Armed Forces
articles.title_hi: अग्निपथ योजना — सशस्त्र बलों में अग्निवीर
articles.summary: Agnipath recruits Agniveers for a short-term tour of duty to create a younger, tech-savvy Armed Forces profile.
articles.summary_hi: अग्निपथ अग्निवीरों को अल्पकालिक सेवा के लिए भर्ती करता है — युवा व तकनीक-कुशल बल।
articles.content:
The Agnipath scheme recruits youth as Agniveers for a four-year engagement in the Army, Navy, and Air Force. A portion may be retained for longer service based on organisational needs.

Aims include reducing average age of forces, cutting pension burden long-term, and building a skilled workforce for civilian life after service with Seva Nidhi package.

For IB ACIO: Agniveers, 4-year tenure, tri-service scheme.
articles.content_hi:
अग्निपथ: अग्निवीर, लगभग 4 वर्ष। तीनों सेनाएं। Seva Nidhi।

IB ACIO: Agnipath, 4 years — याद रखें।
articles.question: Personnel recruited under Agnipath are known as:
articles.question_hi: अग्निपथ के तहत भर्ती कर्मी क्या कहलाते हैं?
articles.explanation: Recruits under Agnipath are called Agniveers.
articles.explanation_hi: अग्निपथ के तहत भर्ती अग्निवीर कहलाते हैं।
articles.moreInfo: Related: today’s Kargil remembrance and modern force reforms.
articles.moreInfo_hi: संबंधित: आज का कारगिल स्मरण और सैन्य सुधार।

articles.title: Financial Inclusion — Jan Dhan and JAM Trinity
articles.title_hi: वित्तीय समावेशन — जन धन और JAM ट्रिनिटी
articles.summary: PM Jan Dhan Yojana expanded bank accounts; JAM (Jan Dhan–Aadhaar–Mobile) enables Direct Benefit Transfer.
articles.summary_hi: पीएम जन धन ने बैंक खाते बढ़ाए; JAM (जन धन–आधार–मोबाइल) से DBT संभव।
articles.content:
Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (2014) is a national financial inclusion mission for universal banking access, RuPay debit cards, and overdraft facilities after conditions.

JAM Trinity — Jan Dhan, Aadhaar, Mobile — underpins Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), reducing leakages in subsidies and welfare.

For IB ACIO: PMJDY 2014, JAM, DBT link.
articles.content_hi:
PMJDY 2014। JAM = Jan Dhan + Aadhaar + Mobile। DBT।

IB ACIO: 2014, JAM — याद रखें।
articles.question: JAM Trinity stands for:
articles.explanation: JAM means Jan Dhan, Aadhaar, and Mobile.
articles.explanation_hi: JAM का अर्थ Jan Dhan, Aadhaar और Mobile है।

articles.title: DRDO — Defence Research and Development Organisation
articles.title_hi: DRDO — रक्षा अनुसंधान एवं विकास संगठन
articles.summary: DRDO is India’s premier defence R&D agency under the Ministry of Defence, behind missiles, radar, and electronic systems.
articles.summary_hi: DRDO रक्षा मंत्रालय के तहत प्रमुख रक्षा R&D एजेंसी — मिसाइल, रडार, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक सिस्टम।
articles.content:
DRDO was formed in 1958 by amalgamating existing defence research units. It develops missiles (Agni, Prithvi, Akash, Astra), LCA support systems, radars, and electronic warfare suites.

DRDO works with DPSUs and private industry for induction. It is central to Atmanirbhar defence technology.

For IB ACIO: formed 1958, MoD, missile and electronics portfolio.
articles.content_hi:
DRDO 1958, रक्षा मंत्रालय। अग्नि, आकाश, LCA समर्थन।

IB ACIO: 1958 — याद रखें।
articles.question: DRDO was established in which year?
articles.moreInfo: Related: Agni series (23 July), Akash (20 July).

articles.title: Line of Control (LoC) and Line of Actual Control (LAC)
articles.title_hi: नियंत्रण रेखा (LoC) और वास्तविक नियंत्रण रेखा (LAC)
articles.summary: LoC refers to the India–Pakistan divide in J&K/Ladakh theatre; LAC refers to the India–China boundary perception.
articles.summary_hi: LoC भारत–पाकिस्तान विभाजन रेखा; LAC भारत–चीन सीमा धारणा।
articles.content:
The Line of Control (LoC) is the military control line between Indian and Pakistani administered areas of the former princely state of Jammu & Kashmir (now including Ladakh context in broader security discourse).

The Line of Actual Control (LAC) separates Indian and Chinese controlled territories in the border areas. Kargil 1999 was along the LoC sector.

For IB ACIO: LoC = India-Pakistan; LAC = India-China — classic distinction.
articles.content_hi:
LoC: भारत–पाक। LAC: भारत–चीन। कारगिल LoC क्षेत्र से जुड़ा।

IB ACIO: LoC vs LAC — याद रखें।
articles.question: The Kargil conflict of 1999 is associated primarily with which line?
articles.question_hi: 1999 का कारगिल संघर्ष मुख्यतः किस रेखा से जुड़ा?
articles.explanation: Kargil 1999 was fought in the LoC sector with Pakistan.
articles.explanation_hi: 1999 कारगिल पाकिस्तान के साथ LoC क्षेत्र में लड़ा गया।
articles.moreInfo_hi: संबंधित: आज का कारगिल विजय दिवस।

articles.title: Armed Forces Special Powers Act (AFSPA) — Basics
articles.summary: AFSPA grants special powers to armed forces in ‘disturbed areas’ notified by the Centre/State under the Act.
articles.summary_hi: AFSPA ‘अशांत क्षेत्रों’ में सशस्त्र बलों को विशेष शक्तियां देता है — केंद्र/राज्य अधिसूचना से।
articles.content:
The Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act has been applied in parts of the Northeast and earlier in J&K (separate legal frameworks historically). It allows notified disturbed areas where armed forces get special powers for maintaining public order.

The Act is debated on security necessity versus human rights concerns. Periodic reviews and partial withdrawals have occurred in some states as security improves.

For IB ACIO: disturbed area notification, special powers, Northeast/J&K association in exams.
articles.content_hi:
AFSPA: अशांत क्षेत्र अधिसूचना, विशेष शक्तियां। सुरक्षा बनाम अधिकार बहस।

IB ACIO: disturbed areas — याद रखें।
articles.question: AFSPA is applicable in areas notified as:
articles.question_hi: AFSPA किन क्षेत्रों में लागू होता है?
articles.explanation: AFSPA applies in areas notified as disturbed areas under the Act.
articles.explanation_hi: AFSPA अधिनियम के तहत अशांत घोषित क्षेत्रों में लागू होता है।
articles.moreInfo: Context: internal security often asked with border/defence topics.
articles.moreInfo_hi: संदर्भ: सीमा/रक्षा विषयों के साथ आंतरिक सुरक्षा।

articles.title: Gallantry Awards Order — Quick Revision
articles.summary: Wartime: Param Vir Chakra > Maha Vir Chakra > Vir Chakra. Peacetime: Ashoka Chakra > Kirti Chakra > Shaurya Chakra.
articles.summary_hi: युद्धकाल: परम वीर चक्र > महा वीर चक्र > वीर चक्र। शांतिकाल: अशोक चक्र > कीर्ति चक्र > शौर्य चक्र।
articles.content:
India’s gallantry awards are divided into wartime and peacetime categories.

Wartime hierarchy: Param Vir Chakra, Maha Vir Chakra, Vir Chakra. Peacetime hierarchy: Ashoka Chakra, Kirti Chakra, Shaurya Chakra.

These awards recognise bravery of Armed Forces and eligible personnel. Kargil Vijay Diwas is a fitting day to revise this list.

For IB ACIO: memorize the two ladders separately.
articles.content_hi:
युद्ध: PVC > MVC > VC। शांति: Ashoka > Kirti > Shaurya।

IB ACIO: दोनों सीढ़ियां अलग याद रखें।
articles.question: Which is the highest peacetime gallantry award in India?
articles.question_hi: भारत में सर्वोच्च शांतिकालीन वीरता पुरस्कार कौन सा है?
articles.explanation: Ashoka Chakra is the highest peacetime gallantry award.
articles.explanation_hi: अशोक चक्र सर्वोच्च शांतिकालीन वीरता पुरस्कार है।

articles.title: National War Memorial and Amar Jawan Jyoti
articles.title_hi: राष्ट्रीय युद्ध स्मारक और अमर जवान ज्योति
articles.summary: The National War Memorial in New Delhi honours soldiers who laid down their lives; Amar Jawan Jyoti flame is associated with it.
articles.summary_hi: नई दिल्ली का राष्ट्रीय युद्ध स्मारक शहीद सैनिकों को समर्पित; अमर जवान ज्योति इससे जुड़ी।
articles.content:
The National War Memorial near India Gate commemorates Indian soldiers who died in wars since Independence. The eternal flame Amar Jawan Jyoti was relocated/merged in the memorial complex in recent years.

On Kargil Vijay Diwas, the Prime Minister and leaders pay homage to martyrs. It is an important national symbol for defence GK.

For IB ACIO: National War Memorial (New Delhi), homage on Kargil Diwas.
articles.content_hi:
राष्ट्रीय युद्ध स्मारक: इंडिया गेट के पास। कारगिल दिवस पर श्रद्धांजलि।

IB ACIO: War Memorial, New Delhi — याद रखें।
articles.question: The National War Memorial is located in:
articles.question_hi: राष्ट्रीय युद्ध स्मारक कहाँ स्थित है?
articles.explanation: The National War Memorial is in New Delhi near India Gate.
articles.explanation_hi: राष्ट्रीय युद्ध स्मारक नई दिल्ली में इंडिया गेट के पास है।
articles.moreInfo: Dras has the Kargil War Memorial in Ladakh.
articles.moreInfo_hi: द्रास में कारगिल वॉर मेमोरियल है।
